description: Machine-readable contract for OpenCyberRange learning-impact metrics. Every entry is a proxy, not a diagnosis. See references/metrics-catalogue.md for the full rationale.

metric_families.retention: Durable recall and application after a delay.
metric_families.load: Working-memory demand placed by the task and environment.
metric_families.speed: Decision quality under a stated time limit.
metric_families.reprioritisation: Reordering work after new evidence or constraints.
metric_families.transfer: Application in a new context and calibration of confidence.
metric_families.supporting: Context measures for delivery, help-seeking, and collaboration.

delayed_checkpoint_score.construct: Durable retrieval and application after a delay.
delayed_checkpoint_score.observable: Score on an equivalent task at 7, 30, or 90 days.

retention_index.construct: Proportion of immediate performance that survives the delay.
retention_index.observable: Ratio of delayed to immediate checkpoint scores.
retention_index.do_not: Compare indices across different delays or task difficulty.

hint_free_delayed_success.observable: Delayed task solved with zero hints and no workbook.

error_recurrence_rate.observable: The same error class appearing again in later sessions.
error_recurrence_rate.do_not: Infer recurrence from a single typo or click.

spacing_adherence.construct: Whether the intended reinforcement schedule was delivered.
spacing_adherence.do_not: Treat adherence as a learner trait.

nasa_tlx_mental_demand.construct: Perceived mental demand of the task.
nasa_tlx_mental_demand.observable: NASA-TLX mental-demand subscale, 0-100, after the task.
nasa_tlx_mental_demand.do_not: Call a high score low intelligence or poor memory.

interruption_recovery_time.construct: Cost of rebuilding task state after an interruption.
interruption_recovery_time.observable: Time from interruption end to the next correct action.
interruption_recovery_time.do_not: Compare labs with different interruption designs.

aid_use.construct: External support required by the task.
aid_use.observable: Workbook opens, hint requests, and note lookups per task.
aid_use.do_not: Rank learners by independence without stating the aid policy.

dual_task_decrement.construct: Performance cost when attention is divided.
dual_task_decrement.observable: Primary-task accuracy or latency with and without a secondary task.
dual_task_decrement.do_not: Run in a live cohort without a pilot and ethics review.

decision_latency.construct: Time to commit to a decision.
decision_latency.observable: Time from the decision prompt to the submitted choice.
decision_latency.do_not: Publish latency alone or treat it as expertise.

decision_accuracy.do_not: Score a defensible alternative as wrong because it was not the preferred click path.

throughput_correct_per_minute.observable: Correct decisions divided by active decision time.
throughput_correct_per_minute.do_not: Compare learners with different reading loads or accommodation time.

timeout_rate.construct: Whether the time limit drove the outcome.
timeout_rate.observable: Decision opportunities that expired without a submission.
timeout_rate.do_not: Treat a timeout as a wrong answer without saying so.

time_to_first_correct_decision.construct: How quickly the learner finds a workable path.
time_to_first_correct_decision.observable: Time from scenario start to the first correct decision.

priority_alignment_top3.construct: Reordering work toward the highest-value items after a change.
priority_alignment_top3.observable: Learner top three priorities and an expert reference ranking.
priority_alignment_top3.do_not: Treat one expert ranking as objective truth.

time_to_replan.construct: How quickly the learner acts on new information.
time_to_replan.observable: Time from the change event to the first consistent action.
time_to_replan.do_not: Count a reflexive click as a re-plan.

priority_inversion_rate.construct: Whether low-value work displaced high-value work.
priority_inversion_rate.observable: High-priority tasks left incomplete while low-priority tasks completed.
priority_inversion_rate.do_not: Call every unfinished task an inversion.

recovery_after_interruption.construct: Ability to resume the right task after a disruption.
recovery_after_interruption.observable: Correct resumption of the interrupted task.
recovery_after_interruption.do_not: Penalise correct abandonment after a scenario change.

novel_context_score.construct: Application of a procedure in an unfamiliar but equivalent context.
novel_context_score.observable: Checkpoint score on a new system, artefact, or scenario.
novel_context_score.do_not: Reuse the same hostnames, flags, or walkthrough steps.

confidence_accuracy_gap.construct: Calibration: knowing when you are unsure.
confidence_accuracy_gap.observable: Confidence rating and correctness per decision.
confidence_accuracy_gap.do_not: Interpret one decision as a calibration trait.

brier_score.observable: Confidence and binary outcome per decision.
brier_score.do_not: Compare across tasks of different difficulty without adjustment.

time_to_criterion.construct: Practice time needed to reach a defined criterion.
time_to_criterion.observable: Sessions or active hours to the criterion.

hint_dependency.construct: How much scaffolding the task required.
hint_dependency.observable: Hint requests relative to decisions or tasks.

help_seeking_quality.construct: Whether help was sought at an appropriate time and specificity.
help_seeking_quality.observable: Rubric score for timing and specificity of help.

collaboration_handoff_quality.construct: Quality of team handoff and escalation.
collaboration_handoff_quality.observable: Rubric score for completeness, accuracy, and escalation.

return_practice_rate.construct: Whether learners return for reinforcement practice.
return_practice_rate.observable: Learners with a second practice session.
